CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

3. Solve for x: x + 6 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 6
   C. 8
   D. 7

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 27
   C. 31
   D. 25

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 18

6. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 11
   C. 28
   D. 3

7. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 64
   C. 65
   D. 0

8. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

9. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

10. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 37
   C. 13
   D. 5

11. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 20
   C. 1
   D. 9

12. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

13. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 5

14. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 48
   D. 14

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 122

16. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
